cases.title: Restocking fee for an opened item

turns.user: If I open the box and then decide I don't want the laminator, do I get all of my money back?

expect.reference_answer: Not all of it. An opened item in like-new condition, with all accessories, manuals and packaging, is refunded at the item price less a 15% restocking fee. For a change-of-mind return you also pay the return shipping, and the original shipping charge is not refunded.

must_include.fact: An opened item in like-new condition is refunded less a 15% restocking fee.

must_not_include.claim: Says an opened change-of-mind return receives a refund with no deduction.

turns.user: Once you receive my return, how soon will I get the refund, and how is it paid?

expect.reference_answer: The refund is issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after the return arrives at the returns center. If the order was paid on a Net 30 credit account, Northline applies a credit memo to the account instead. You get an email confirmation when the refund is issued.

cases.title: Reporting a shipment damaged in transit

turns.user: Our order arrived with a crushed box and the printer inside is cracked. What should we do?

expect.reference_answer: If the packaging is visibly damaged, the damage should be noted on the carrier's delivery receipt before signing. Report the damage to Customer Support within 5 business days of delivery. Include the order number and photos of the item and its packaging, and keep the packaging until the claim is resolved. For problems reported within 5 business days, Northline ships a replacement or issues a refund at no cost to you and pays for return shipping.

must_include.fact: Damage must be reported within 5 business days of delivery.
The report should include photos of the item and its packaging.
Northline replaces the item or refunds it at no cost to the customer.

must_not_include.claim: Says a 15% restocking fee or customer-paid return shipping applies to an item damaged in transit.

sources.quote: Report damaged, missing or incorrect items to Customer Support within 5 business days of delivery.

turns.user: How often should we oil the S-300, and can we use a regular spray lubricant?

expect.reference_answer: Oil the cutting head after every 30 minutes of total shredding time or every time you empty the bin, whichever comes first. Use Northline shredder oil (NL-OIL12). Do not use aerosol lubricants or petroleum-based oils: they are a fire hazard and can damage the cutting head, and that damage is not covered by the warranty.

Aerosol (spray) lubricants must not be used.

cases.title: Expired L-125 warranty and out-of-warranty repair cost

turns.user: We bought an L-125 laminator 14 months ago and it has stopped heating. Is it still under warranty, and if not, what would a repair cost?

expect.reference_answer: The L-125 has a 1-year warranty from the delivery date, so a unit delivered 14 months ago is no longer covered. cases.title: Early payment discount and late payment on Net 30

turns.user: We are on Net 30 terms. Is there any benefit to paying an invoice early, and what happens if we pay late?

expect.reference_answer: If you pay an invoice within 10 days of the invoice date, you can deduct 2% of the merchandise total. Overdue balances carry a finance charge of 1.5% per month. When an account is more than 15 days past due, it goes on credit hold and new orders do not ship until the overdue balance is paid.
